primitives.name: Order-Statistic Feature Expansion
primitives.verbatim_quote: Equations & assumptions - Order-statistic feature expansion: for each of 28 player statistics, the five lineup members' values are sorted and the full sorted vector (min through max) enters the feature set, giving 28 × 5 = 140 predictors.
primitives.assumptions: Elite status is a valid quality proxy; order statistics capture synergy without interaction terms; classifier unanimity filters noise.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Collinearity among statistics degrades predictive power; small-sample plus-minus introduces bias.

The unanimous classifier enforces consistency across multiple models, filtering noise. Restricted validation ensures the model learns combinatorial rules rather than memorizing specific teams. This framework naturally resizes to DFS by treating each roster as a lineup and applying the ANC rule to select high-conviction stacks.
